posts.name: Virat Kohli
posts.caption: First Indian batter to 14,000 T20 runs! 9th IPL hundred this season. Handshake snub of Travis Head goes viral. RCB through to playoffs.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar Raw & Undekha streaming on Netflix May 22! Pralay shoot begins August 2026 with Rs 300 crore budget. Dhurandhar heading to Japan July 10.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: KING locked for Christmas 2026! December 24 release confirmed. Deepika Padukone and Suhana Khan co-star in Siddharth Anand's action thriller. Rs 350 crore budget.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Co-starring with SRK in King this Christmas 2026. Siddharth Anand directs this action thriller with Rs 350 crore budget.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Set to star as a lawyer in a dynamic new Hollywood film. Priyanka continues bridging Bollywood and Hollywood with powerful roles.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Dil-Luminati Tour continues across North America! Sold-out shows in Shreya Ghoshal's competition. The Punjabi King keeps breaking records globally.

posts.name: Hardik Pandya
posts.caption: Fined 10% match fee for 'abuse of cricket equipment' in KKR loss. A tough IPL 2026: 172 runs, 4 wickets in 9 matches. MI captaincy under scrutiny.

posts.name: MS Dhoni
posts.caption: Didn't play a single IPL 2026 game. Calf strain and thumb injury. CSK eliminated. The legend's future remains cricket's biggest question at 44.

posts.name: Mark Zuckerberg
posts.caption: 'Success isn't a given. AI is the most consequential technology of our lifetimes.' Meta cuts 8,000 jobs amid biggest AI push in company history.

posts.name: Jensen Huang
posts.caption: Nvidia Q1 revenue hits $82 BILLION — 10x from three years ago. Vera CPU opens 'brand new $200 billion' market. Calls stock stagnation 'one of the mysteries of the universe.'

posts.name: D Gukesh
posts.caption: World Chess Champion faces criticism from Nepomniachtchi: 'Every top Grandmaster would have a good chance against him.' Post-Candidates form under scrutiny.

posts.name: Narendra Modi
posts.caption: PM Modi visits Italy for talks with Meloni and Cyprus President. 'Melody' candy gift goes viral. India to host Quad Foreign Ministers meet on May 26.

posts.name: Travis Head
posts.caption: Instagram story after Virat Kohli handshake controversy goes viral! The SRH vs RCB clash continues to generate debate across the cricket world.

posts.name: Ajay Banga
posts.caption: World Bank President backs 'Small AI' for farmers at ATX Singapore 2026. Crisis toolkit gives countries access to $60-100 billion. Indian-American leading global development.

posts.name: Sunny Deol
posts.caption: Lahore 1947 releasing globally August 13, 2026. Directed by Rajkumar Santoshi, produced by Aamir Khan. Reuniting after three decades!

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.caption: Posts AI video of Colbert in dumpster. Defends $1.8B anti-weaponization fund. Skips Don Jr.'s Bahamas wedding: 'love for the United States.'

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.caption: SpaceX IPO filing at $1.25 trillion valuation. Nvidia concedes China chip market to Huawei. Still posting 25-35 times daily on X.

posts.name: Mukesh Ambani
posts.caption: Met Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at AI Summit. Reliance expanding into power and telecom. Battles Adani for Asia's richest spot.

posts.name: Gautam Adani
posts.caption: Overtakes Mukesh Ambani as Asia's richest man. Adani Group and Reliance collaborating in fuel retail. Building India's infrastructure empire.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Bollywood's most bankable star continues with multiple projects in the pipeline and growing international profile.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Stree franchise dominance continues. India's social media queen remains the most-followed Indian actress on Instagram.

posts.name: Keir Starmer
posts.caption: UK PM announces free summer bus travel for kids. Congratulates Arsenal on PL title. Co-chairs Hormuz Strait meeting with Macron.
